g.text: 77.5 × 56.6 mm · top view · plugs onto the roboRIO MXP port

circle.title: MXP 34-pin (2x17, 0.1 in) socket underneath; plugs onto the roboRIO MXP; 5 V power, SPI/I2C/UART, I/O
USB Mini-B (power, data, firmware; 5 V)
DIO 9 (3-pin: GND edge, V, signal) = roboRIO DIO 23 / PWM 19
DIO 8 (3-pin: GND edge, V, signal) = roboRIO DIO 22 / PWM 18
DIO 7 (3-pin: GND edge, V, signal) = roboRIO DIO 21 / PWM 17
DIO 6 (3-pin: GND edge, V, signal) = roboRIO DIO 20 / PWM 16
DIO 5 (3-pin: GND edge, V, signal) = roboRIO DIO 19 / PWM 15
DIO 4 (3-pin: GND edge, V, signal) = roboRIO DIO 18 / PWM 14
DIO 3 (3-pin: GND edge, V, signal) = roboRIO DIO 13 / PWM 13
DIO 2 (3-pin: GND edge, V, signal) = roboRIO DIO 12 / PWM 12
DIO 1 (3-pin: GND edge, V, signal) = roboRIO DIO 11 / PWM 11
DIO 0 (3-pin: GND edge, V, signal) = roboRIO DIO 10 / PWM 10
Analog in 3 (roboRIO AI 7)
Analog in 2 (roboRIO AI 6)
Analog in 1 (roboRIO AI 5)
Analog in 0 (roboRIO AI 4)
Analog out 1 (roboRIO AO 1)
Analog out 0 (roboRIO AO 0)
External I2C header VCC/GND/DAT/CLK (0.1 in), for FTC hubs
MXP UART breakout (0.1 in right-angle header): TX, RX, +, GND
MXP SPI breakout (0.1 in right-angle header): CS, MISO, MOSI, SCK, +, GND
MXP I2C breakout (0.1 in right-angle header): SDA, SCL, +, GND
